exposure: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 58 primiparous women, with some undergoing vaginal delivery and some undergoing cesarean section in the second stage of labor
finding: There was no correlation between the duration of the second stage of labor and pelvic floor muscle strength at 6 weeks postpartum, regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Pelvic floor muscle strength at 6 weeks postpartum was not affected by duration of the second stage of labor, regardless of whether birth was vaginal or via cesarean section.
